capabilities: Display folder contents as masonry tiles
Create pin boards and pin files to them
Add tags to items and pins
Filter tiles by name or tag in a search bar
Drag and drop files to pin or move them
disambiguation: Not a Canvas whiteboard; it displays existing files and pin records as tiles rather than providing a free-form drawing surface.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lists notes and images as plain rows, with no visual tiled way to browse a folder or a curated set of files.
summary: Masonry view plugin that renders folder contents and pin boards as Pinterest-style tile grids with tags, filtering, and drag-and-drop.
